decisions.reason: The source message's color instruction is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the decorative-button reference requires no further color-state change.
The bottom-logo instruction is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and the decorative-button reference does not further change support-base branding.
The source distinguishes recreated buttons from lighting surrounding the power button and does not change the existing requirement for LED lighting around the bowls.
The Deck 1 and Deck 2 label requirement is already established by a same-message INTRODUCE; the decorative-button reference adds no further label change.
The power-button lighting instruction is already captured by a same-message INTRODUCE, and recreating the buttons does not independently alter that lighting state.
The back-panel design and font instruction is already captured by a same-message INTRODUCE; the decorative-button reference requires no additional back-panel update.
Recreating the rendered button style does not necessarily remove or alter the independently specified cursive K markings or their beige color.
The source message does not discuss measurement-ring markings, and changing the decorative button reference leaves the bowl markings valid unchanged.
The source's bottom-logo instruction concerns support-base branding, not the separately positioned machine placards or their wording and viewing orientations.
The decorative appearance of buttons has no necessary effect on bowl capacity, depth, or enclosure-size constraints.
Recreating button appearance does not change the master power control's functionality or its centered front-panel location.
The decorative button-reference change has no necessary effect on whisk selection, positioning, mixing quality, or frothing performance.
